title: ConcurrencyProbeResult
description: Result of a concurrency probe run: N parallel tools/call requests, optionally repeated over several iterations. Normative schema for the contract defined in docs/concurrency-probe.md.

arguments.description: The exact arguments object sent to every tools/call of this run.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the run started (before the first call was dispatched).

endedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the run settled (all executed calls finished, or cancellation settled).

completed.description: false iff the run was cancelled or aborted before all configured iterations finished.

cancelledAt.description: Present iff completed === false and the termination was a user cancellation.

abortedReason.description: Present iff completed === false and the termination was caused by a transport-level failure (e.g. connection drop).

totalCalls.description: Number of executed calls. Equals successCount + errorCount + timeoutCount + cancelledCount. Less than concurrency * iterations when the run was cancelled or aborted.

latencyMs.description: Latency percentiles over successful calls only (nearest-rank method). Absent when successCount === 0.

bodyEquality.description: Response-body equality check across successful calls.

distinctHashes.description: Number of distinct bodyHash values among successful calls. 0 iff no-success.

failureGroups.description: Calls with status error or timeout, grouped by exact errorMessage, sorted by count descending.

callIndices.description: Global index values of the calls in this group; used by the UI to deep-link into the Timeline.

calls.description: One record per executed call, in dispatch order (global index order).

index.description: Global 0-based call index: iteration * concurrency + lane.

errorMessage.description: Present iff status is error or timeout.

bodyHash.description: SHA-256 hex of the canonical JSON serialization of the CompatibilityCallToolResult. Present iff status is success.

bodyHashTruncated.description: true iff the hash was computed over a truncated canonical form (see spec 5).

timelineCorrelationId.description: Timeline correlation id of the request/response pair, when timeline recording is enabled.
